put.description: Store the raw request body as uploads/<name>. The name must be a plain .tif/.tiff file name.

get.description: The look a new course starts with, for views of things that are not courses yet (a GeoTIFF's hillshade).
The saved editor state (defaults when there is none or it is unreadable).

put.description: Replace the course's look. It changes no raster, so nothing is built.

post.description: The trees the build would write for these unsaved tree edits and forest settings, as trees.bin's bytes. Nothing is saved or built.

get.description: The sculpting delta file, or an empty body when nothing was sculpted.

post.description: Crop the map in place. The editor saves what it has first and reloads after; the previous map is kept so the crop can be taken back.
Put the map and design back as they were before the newest crop.
Build immediately and wait for it (the editor normally just saves and lets the debounced build run).

get.description: A file of a bundle (course.json, PNGs, trees.bin), exactly as the game will download it.

AerialMeta.title: AerialMeta
AerialMeta.description: Where a bundle's aerial image sits in course metres (x east, z south) and its pixel size.

Blob-Input.title: Blob
Blob-Input.description: A faceted ball, for a tree's crown, squashed to radii (rx, ry, rz) about (cx, cy, cz).

Blob-Output.title: Blob
Blob-Output.description: A faceted ball, for a tree's crown, squashed to radii (rx, ry, rz) about (cx, cy, cz).

BoundsArea-Input.title: BoundsArea
BoundsArea-Input.description:
Part of the ground that is in bounds for one hole. A hole's in-bounds ground is the union of its areas; a hole
with none yet is in bounds everywhere (so unfinished holes are not flagged as out of bounds).

BoundsArea-Output.title: BoundsArea
BoundsArea-Output.description:
Part of the ground that is in bounds for one hole. A hole's in-bounds ground is the union of its areas; a hole
with none yet is in bounds everywhere (so unfinished holes are not flagged as out of bounds).

BuildStatus.title: BuildStatus
BuildStatus.description: Where the build for a bundle stands. `id` increases with every finished build; the viewer reloads on change.

Clearing.title: Clearing
Clearing.description: A circle drawn by hand where the forest is not planted.

CropRequest.title: CropRequest
CropRequest.description: The part of the map to keep, in whole course metres: the samples from x0 to x1 east and z0 to z1 south, edges included.

DesignHole-Input.title: DesignHole
DesignHole-Input.description: A hole as designed. The route may still be unfinished (fewer than 2 points); the build skips such holes.

DesignHole-Output.title: DesignHole
DesignHole-Output.description: A hole as designed. The route may still be unfinished (fewer than 2 points); the build skips such holes.

DesignResponse.title: DesignResponse
DesignResponse.description: What the editor loads: the design, and the course's look, which is kept in course.json and edited with the rest.

EditorState-Input.title: EditorState
EditorState-Input.description: `.course_maker/editor.json`: UI state, per user. Safe to delete; never needed to rebuild a bundle.

EditorState-Output.title: EditorState
EditorState-Output.description: `.course_maker/editor.json`: UI state, per user. Safe to delete; never needed to rebuild a bundle.

ElevationLayer.title: ElevationLayer
ElevationLayer.description: 16-bit heights in R/G of a PNG, as in the bundle format; A = 0 marks no data.

ForestSettings-Input.title: ForestSettings
ForestSettings-Input.description: How a forest patch (a woods region) is planted. docs/tree-editor-plan.md, section 3.

ForestSettings-Output.title: ForestSettings
ForestSettings-Output.description: How a forest patch (a woods region) is planted. docs/tree-editor-plan.md, section 3.

Frustum-Input.title: Frustum
Frustum-Input.description: A cone or a frustum, for a tree: `sides` faces from a ring at y0 to a ring at y1. Heights are fractions of the tree's.

Frustum-Output.title: Frustum
Frustum-Output.description: A cone or a frustum, for a tree: `sides` faces from a ring at y0 to a ring at y1. Heights are fractions of the tree's.

HeightBase.title: HeightBase
HeightBase.description: The pristine baked heights (`GET /api/bundle/design/height/base.png`) are encoded against this range.

Layout-Input.title: Layout
Layout-Input.description: Course metadata and holes. `name` and `attribution`, when set, override what the bake wrote.

Layout-Output.title: Layout
Layout-Output.description: Course metadata and holes. `name` and `attribution`, when set, override what the bake wrote.

PlacedTree.title: PlacedTree
PlacedTree.description: A tree put down by hand. It is a plain tree in trees.bin, and the forest does not grow within its crown.

Region-Input.title: Region
Region-Input.description: A surface polygon. Order in the file is painter's order: later regions are drawn over earlier ones.

Region-Output.title: Region
Region-Output.description: A surface polygon. Order in the file is painter's order: later regions are drawn over earlier ones.

ReliefLook-Input.title: ReliefLook
ReliefLook-Input.description: How the ground's slope is worked out for lighting.

ReliefLook-Output.title: ReliefLook
ReliefLook-Output.description: How the ground's slope is worked out for lighting.

Report.title: Report
Report.description: The result of validating a bundle.

Shadows.title: Shadows
Shadows.description: How the sun's shadows look. How crisp they are (map size, slices) is a quality setting of the viewer, not the course's.

Sun.title: Sun
Sun.description: Where the sun is: a place, a time of year and a time of day.

Surface-Input.title: Surface
Surface-Input.description: How one surface class is coloured, and what grows on it. The look has one for each class, in class order.

Surface-Output.title: Surface
Surface-Output.description: How one surface class is coloured, and what grows on it. The look has one for each class, in class order.

TifView.title: TifView
TifView.description: A GeoTIFF rendered for the viewer. Rendered pixels may be decimated from the source.

TreeEdits-Input.title: TreeEdits
TreeEdits-Input.description: `.course_maker/design/trees.json`: the woods defaults and the hand edits. Clearings around placed trees and landmarks are derived at build time, not stored.

TreeEdits-Output.title: TreeEdits
TreeEdits-Output.description: `.course_maker/design/trees.json`: the woods defaults and the hand edits. Clearings around placed trees and landmarks are derived at build time, not stored.

TreeKind-Input.title: TreeKind
TreeKind-Input.description: One tree model, 1 unit tall standing on the ground; trees.bin's kind picks which, wrapping past the last.

TreeKind-Output.title: TreeKind
TreeKind-Output.description: One tree model, 1 unit tall standing on the ground; trees.bin's kind picks which, wrapping past the last.

TreesPreview.title: TreesPreview
TreesPreview.description:
What the editor sends to see trees before saving them: the tree edits, and the forest settings of the woods patches that have their own
(by region id; null for a patch on the woods defaults). The outlines are the saved ones.

Tufts-Input.title: Tufts
Tufts-Input.description: The standing grass in the rough: clumps of blades, each blade a thin tapered strip that leans out from the middle of its clump.

Tufts-Output.title: Tufts
Tufts-Output.description: The standing grass in the rough: clumps of blades, each blade a thin tapered strip that leans out from the middle of its clump.

Viewer-Input.title: Viewer
Viewer-Input.description: The 3D view's own settings: what it draws and how far. The viewer's, not the course's look (that is in course.json).

Viewer-Output.title: Viewer
Viewer-Output.description: The 3D view's own settings: what it draws and how far. The viewer's, not the course's look (that is in course.json).

Viewport.title: Viewport
Viewport.description: The map view: centre in course metres, and pixels per metre. Independent of the window size.
